ja305:1.1: N' atthi loke raho nāma pāpakammaṃ pakubbato, passanti vanabhūtāni, taṃ bālo maññatī raho.
ja305:2.1: Ahaṃ raho na passāmi, suññaṃ vāpi na vijjati, yattha aññaṃ na passāmi asuññaṃ hoti tam mayā ti.
ja305:3.1: Dujjacco ca ajacco ca nando ca sukhavacchano vajjho addhuvasīlo ca te dhammaṃ jahum atthikā.
ja305:4.1: Brāhmaṇo ca kathaṃ jahe sabbadhammāna pāragū yo dhammam anupāleti dhitimā saccanikkamo ti.
